name: brain
description: reddb.io brain plugin - project-local RedDB knowledge repository for freeform captures and graph connections.

interface.longDescription: RedSkills Brain creates a project-local RedDB knowledge repository under .red/brain. It captures typed artifacts, stores graph connections, exposes CLI and MCP operations, and initializes automatically when supported agent sessions start in a workspace.
defaultPrompt: Use $capture to save this into the project Brain.
Search Brain before answering a project-history question.
Run $status to inspect the project Brain store.
Run $view to open Brain artifacts and typed connections in red-ui.
